|-|Trivia=
* The teasers are a reference to a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4kU0XCVey_U quote] from [[wikipedia:Full Metal Jacket|Full Metal Jacket]].
* '''Commando''' is a reference to the 1985 film ''[[wikipedia:Commando (1985 film)|Commando]]'', starring [[wikipedia:Arnold Schwarzenegger|Arnold Schwarzenegger]] who is referenced in the name and description of the mask received upon its completion.
* The '''Public Enemies''' achievement is a reference to the Long Island hip-hop group [[wikipedia:Public Enemy (group)|Public Enemy]] and its lead vocalist, rapper [[wikipedia:Chuck D|Chuck D]].
* '''Inception''' is a reference to a scene in the film ''[[wikipedia:Inception|Inception]]'' where the character Arthur fires on the host's "defenses" using an [[wikipedia:FN SCAR|FN-SCAR]], though the variant used in said film is a 5.56x45mm FN SCAR-L instead of the SCAR-H the Eagle Heavy was based on.
